title: HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2610.24501v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Irregular time series require models to answer temporal queries at arbitrary coordinates, yet existing approaches typically retain observation-dependent representations that must be repeatedly resolved for each query. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), a functional-memory attention operator that compiles an irregular history into a reusable coordinate-addressable state. Instead of storing observation-indexed tokens or latent trajectories, HiPPO-FM writes observations into a fixed-rank functional space and performs direct coordinate evaluation through matched functional geometry. Kernel-smoothed HiPPO coordinates and Gram-based readout define a shared write/read mechanism, while observed-support self-attention enables content-dependent representations before compression. translated_title: HiPPO函数记忆：面向不规则时间序列的坐标可查询注意力
translated_abstract: 不规则时间序列要求模型能够在任意时间坐标处回答查询，然而现有方法通常保留依赖于观测的表示，需要在每次查询时反复解析。我们提出了HiPPO函数记忆，这是一种函数式记忆注意力算子，能够将不规则的历史数据编译为可重用的、可按坐标寻址的状态。HiPPO-FM不再存储以观测为索引的token或潜在轨迹，而是将观测写入固定秩的函数空间，并通过匹配的函数几何直接进行坐标求值。核平滑的HiPPO坐标与基于Gram矩阵的读出机制定义了共享的写入/读取机制，而基于观测支撑集的自注意力则能在压缩之前实现内容相关的表示。我们刻画了由此诱导的有限维查询空间，并推导出误差分解，将函数几何近似误差与学习……相分离。
tldr: 提出HiPPO函数记忆（HiPPO-FM），一种将不规则时间序列历史编译为可重用的坐标可寻址函数状态的注意力算子，可在任意时间坐标处直接求值查询，无需为每个查询反复解析观测相关表示。
en_tdlr: HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM) is a functional-memory attention operator that compiles irregular time-series history into a reusable coordinate-addressable state, enabling direct coordinate-queryable evaluation at arbitrary time points without repeatedly resolving observation-dependent representations.
